data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Tokenomics of Inter-Agent Grilling, Critic Loops, and Multi-Agent Debate — Coasian Boundaries and Extensive-Margin Pruning
data.description: Authoritative mathematical, empirical, and architectural framework for governing the token economics of inter-agent grilling, generator-critic verification loops, and multi-agent debate on Google Cloud ADK 2.0 and A2A Protocol — deriving Coase's Theory of the Firm equilibrium agent count (N*), proving Zhu (2026) Section 6.2 verification/testing dominance, and implementing extensive-margin pruning (S2-MAD, DebateOCR, AgentPrune, AgentDropout, G-Designer, ARG-Designer, GTD).
